title: North Sentinel Island analogy for hidden non-human observers
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of North Sentinel Island analogy for hidden non-human observers, about present day at North Sentinel Island, India, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I've given the example of North Sentinel Island where India manages North Sentinel Island but doesn't land there. And in such a circumstance, there would be a fermy paradox among the natives of North Sentinel Island.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, compares our situation to North Sentinel Island, a remote island that India governs but whose people it leaves alone and never visits. He says the islanders could wonder why nobody out there ever shows up, which is the same puzzle we face when we ask why we see no sign of other intelligent life. His point is that non-human observers could be watching us while deliberately choosing not to land.
